appointments.reschedule.panelIntro: Pick another time at {{facility}}. You keep your current appointment until the new one is confirmed.
appointments.reschedule.loadError: We could not load the available times.
appointments.reschedule.noSlotsBody: This facility has no other open times right now. Your appointment on {{when}} is unchanged.
appointments.reschedule.emptyDayBody: Choose another date, or jump to the next opening.
appointments.reschedule.selectPrompt: Select a new time to continue

appointments.reschedule.keptOriginalUnkn: Your original appointment has not been changed. Nothing was released.

appointments.reschedule.errAuth: Please sign in again to move this appointment.
appointments.reschedule.errServer: Something went wrong at our end.
appointments.reschedule.errUnknown: We could not move this appointment.
